text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having decided to run in the Champions Cup, Hokko Tarumae was more motivated than ever for her training, but—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: âHup!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...! Acute-san...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: âHoooooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible...! What sharp acceleration...!
If she unleashes that on the final stretch—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, one more rep, please!
I have to push myself even harder...!
choice_data_list: No, let's take a break here as planned.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: But...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's fine that Hokko Tarumae feels the gap in ability between herself and Wonder Acute and the others, and works desperately to close it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, there is a limit to everything.
If she gets too fired up and ends up injuring herself,
it will all be for nothing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
I'm sorry. I'll take a short break.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She listened obediently,
but it felt like her mind was still wandering elsewhere...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If only there were some way to help her relax all that built-up tension in her shoulders—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"You're on break right now, right?
A few of us from class are getting together to hang out—
do you want to join, Tarumae?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
No, but I really want to train—
choice_data_list: Why don't you take a little break and clear your head?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a godsend. Spending time with friends
like Copano Rickey might help loosen
some of the tight tension built up inside.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
Tarumae's Trainer really catches on quick!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Well, if you say so, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: It's settled! Let's go, let's go~☆

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —How about some explosive watermelon splitting?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —A barbecue under the summer sky sounds great, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae's classmates seem to be
happily discussing something...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The girl on the left is Kawakami Princess.
She seems particularly fixated on being a "princess,"
and is an Umamusume known for her powerful running—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The girl on the right is Hishi Akebono.
With a large build and a big heart to match,
she's an umamusume overflowing with power as well.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: What are you... talking about?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: We're discussing what to play first! ☆

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
In the beach episode of 『Everlasting Summer Shine☆Purify!』,
they said, 'Watermelon splitting is what makes summer the best!'
It will definitely be fun!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Eat a hearty barbecue and enjoy this summer!
That would definitely be lots of fun too~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, both are such tempting suggestions!
I can't decide which one to do first~

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Which one would you like to start with, Tarumae-san?
Which one are you going to start with, Tarumae-chan?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't put me on the spot like that...!
Trainer!
Which one do you think is better?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you put me on the spot so suddenly...
for now, let's—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
“—Two steps to the right! Yes!
Now straight ahead! Just a little more!”

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Is it around here?! It must be right around here, yes?!
Very well!! Here I come!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait! Just half a step more—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Doooossshhheeeeyyy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~, a whole pillar of sand shot up...!
Maybe that's a good omen too, though♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I-It split the watermelon just by grazing it...
If it had landed a direct hit, it would've been pulverized,
so all's well that ends well, maybe...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ptoo, ptooey... Sand got in my mouth...!
Nevertheless, I did it~!
I smashed it to pieces, splendidly~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's slice it up right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, everyone shared the sliced watermelon together, creating another sweet summer memory—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: S-So many ingredients...?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The staff at the lodge prepared it for us~! I thought we could all eat it together as a class! I'll do the cooking, so everyone just relax, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "No, no, no! Even if Akebono-san is an amazing cook, having her handle this massive amount all by herself is way too hard! It's not right...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ricky! Kawakami-san! Help me out!
I'll give you instructions on what to do!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me!
Feel free to work me to the bone!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Okaaaay!
Doing it together means we can definitely
eat more, faster☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪
Tarumae-chan, everyone, thank you!
All right, let's give it our all~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, everyone cooperated to enjoy a barbecue, creating another sweet summer memory—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Phew... Somehow, evening came in the blink of an eye, didn't it?
choice_data_list: Doesn't that just mean you had that much fun?
Doesn't that just mean you had that much fun?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
It was pretty chaotic, but somehow, it was fun.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm.
Having fun is always a good thing~.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Acute-san...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: To keep going for a long time, you have to relax every now and then, you know?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I was taking a break from training, drinking some tea while listening to the waves.
It's so relaxing, you know~

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~...
The sunset feels wonderful, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
“......Um, Acute-san?
Was that all you called me over for...?”

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right, that's right.
Once I calmed down, it totally slipped my mind. How embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
—For the upcoming "Champions Cup."
I heard you're entering too, Tarumae-chan?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I intend to take on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufu, really lookin' forward to it, ain't ya?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh—
Looking forward to it...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for so long to run alongside Tarumae-chan.
Now that it's coming true, I'm so happy and excited.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Let's give it everything we've got.
As fellow Umamusume running the same dirt track."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes...! I swear I'll catch up to Acute-san...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I could feel the tension ease from Hokko Tarumae's shoulders, while a fierce fighting spirit ignited within her in a positive way—
